sentences.show: In the biggest sea battle in centuries, one wounded soldier would later write Don Quixote.
It was fought on this day in 1571, at Lepanto, off Greece.
Spain, Venice and their allies, against the Ottoman fleet.
More than 450 warships, most rowed by hand.
The flagships crashed together. Soldiers fought hand to hand.
It is said some janissaries ran out of weapons, and threw oranges and lemons.
On the galley Marquesa, a young soldier sick with malaria fought anyway.
He was shot twice in the chest, and once in the left arm, which he never used again.
His name was Miguel de Cervantes.
34 years later, he published Don Quixote.
Also on this day: Edgar Allan Poe died in a mystery never solved, and a Soviet probe photographed the Moon's far side.
